title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: The bowl-shaped {Ln19Ni21} unit can dimerize to dumbbell-like Ln42Ni38 or polymerize to helical (Ln18Ni24)n chains when anions, metal ions, or auxiliary ligands bridge the bowls.
explanation: These are presented as additional IDA-protected building units beyond the parallelepiped and heart-shaped families. The review explicitly says the formation mechanism of these units is still inconclusive.
scope: IDA-protected Ln-Ni clusters based on the {Ln19Ni21} bowl.
conditions: Bridging by anions, metal ions, or auxiliary ligands.
